name: HealthLens-AI
description: Explainable ML platform for early diabetes risk analysis: EDA, 4-model comparison (LR, Decision Tree, Random Forest, XGBoost), SHAP explanations and a Streamlit dashboard. Educational prototype, not a medical device.

paragraphs: An end-to-end data science project: EDA, four machine-learning models, honest evaluation, SHAP explanations and an interactive Streamlit dashboard, built on the public Pima Indians Diabetes Database.

Educational and research prototype. Not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat or screen for any condition and must not replace advice from a healthcare professional. Predicted values are model-estimated probabilities, not a person's real risk.
features: Dataset Explorer - browse records, validation, upload your own compatible CSV, source and limitations
Exploratory Analysis - missing/impossible zeros, duplicates, distributions, outliers, Mann-Whitney + effect sizes, correlations, auto-generated findings
Health Risk Prediction - validated inputs, "not measured" option, 4-model probabilities, reliability warnings, SHAP explanation in plain English
Model Comparison - Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, XGBoost; metrics, ROC, confusion matrices, threshold analysis, cross-validation, bootstrap CIs, age-group check
Explainable AI - SHAP global importance, beeswarm summary, per-record explanation, cross-model comparison
